title: Property Coverage Disclosure
description: Whether a product's publisher_properties[] is an exhaustive description of the properties on which the product may deliver. complete: the list is exhaustive and delivery outside it is non-conformant. partial: the list names some properties but is explicitly non-exhaustive and is not a delivery-containment guarantee. undisclosed: the seller discloses no property roster; publisher_properties is empty.

enumDescriptions.complete: publisher_properties[] exhaustively describes every property on which the product may deliver. This is the meaning when property_coverage is absent. Delivery outside the list is non-conformant.
enumDescriptions.partial: publisher_properties[] names properties the seller knows are included but is explicitly non-exhaustive. Buyers MUST NOT treat it as a delivery-containment guarantee.
enumDescriptions.undisclosed: The seller discloses no underlying property roster; publisher_properties is empty. The product may still be buyable, and buyers apply their own policy to opaque inventory.
